log.msg: **The record schema Mike wants already existed on 2026-08-14** — `ai/2026-08-14/vision-sonnet/layout-analysis.json`: per image {file, url, viewport_width, image_px, file_bytes, analysis_tokens{input,cache_write,cache_read,output,total}, analysis_cost_usd, api_ms, wall_ms, findings{regions[], width_use, issues[{severity,what,where}], quality}} + session totals. 15 shots at 400/1920/3440, tracked IN the repo. Siblings vision-haiku-opus + vision-report did the cross-model comparison. It was never given a browse page, and 2026-08-17 rebuilt a thinner version of it (numeric scores only) instead of reusing it.

**Before + After + Accept ALREADY EXISTS AND WORKS** — verified headless just now. `/framework/ext/DesignTool/audit/` → click a rows leading-rule button → `audit/twin.js` renders two same-origin iframes of the page at the audit width (right one with the proposed declarations injected as a stylesheet), the whole CSS diff as text, and a working **Accept into the review queue** button that RPC-writes `ext/DesignTool/audit/accepted.css` (file does not exist yet = nobody has clicked it). `mirror.js` is the element-level twin (the offending node cloned twice, fix applied inline). Both panes also carry `vision.js` Ask-Claude buttons. Probe: {twin:true, panes:2, accept:[Accept into the review queue], decl: real 2-rule sheet, vision_btn: 2}. **The only missing half: the fixes come from rules.js/polish.js `decl:`, never from a vision models prose.**

Verified live: `/screenshot?path=<abs>` returns 200 image/png (loopback-only, os.tmpdir-fenced) — this IS the `?screenshot` query string Mike half-remembers. `/framework/ai/2026-08-17/vision-browse/` renders 18 rows x 5 axis blocks with the full sentence each. `/framework/ext/DesignTool/audit/` lists 192 rows / 169 finding buttons.

**The number that frames everything: ~2,150 screenshots taken (1,874 pngs across scratchpads, 271 `ask-shot-*.png` in the tmp root from Shot.js — 116 TODAY — plus 97 under public/framework/ai). Eight carry a `shot` log line. Eighteen carry prose feedback. Zero have their prompt stored beside their output.** Cost per image measured: haiku $0.010, sonnet $0.035, sonnet whole-page $0.03-0.17. Anti-pattern: 2026-08-14 resumed ONE session 15x and paid $0.120/image on 2M cache-read tokens — 3.5x the batch rate for worse independence. Fresh session per image is cheaper AND cleaner; image tokens scale with area, so a card crop is ~10x cheaper than 1280x800.

**Gitignore gap:** `.gitignore` names node_modules, directory.json, public/data/, usage.json — and NO pngs. 97 screenshots sit under public/framework/ai (48 tracked from 08-14/08-15, 49 untracked from today: designtool-ui/shots 13, designtool-ui-build/shots 12, vision-browse/shots 2, ...). Mike: `We DONT want screenshots logged to the repo (not necessarily anyway)`. Recommend `public/framework/ai/**/*.png` in .gitignore, and a RULE#12 that is enforced rather than cited.

assign.outcome: **~2,150 screenshots taken. 8 logged. 18 have prose feedback. 0 have their prompt in the repo.** The machinery Mike asked for is already built across four layers (`Shot.js` → `/screenshot?path=` → `Ask.js`/`ext/Ask` → `DesignTool/vision.js`) and every piece works — nothing keeps the record. **The analysis he loved is `vision-baseline/baseline.json`** (18 pages × 5 axes of prose, `claude-opus-5[1m]`); **its prompt is not in the repo** — it is `prompt.txt` in a temp scratchpad, one sweep from gone, quoted verbatim in proposal.md along with the two others. **`ext/DesignTool/audit/twin.js` ALREADY IS the Before + After + Accept UX** — verified live: two same-origin iframes, injected proposal stylesheet, real CSS diff, a working `Accept into the review queue` button. Its fixes just come from `rules.js` `decl:` instead of a vision model; emit the same `{sel, decl, rule, why}` shape and it renders a model's proposal unchanged. Recommendation: no `ext/ScreenshotTool` — a headless runner + one browse page inside `ext/DesignTool/vision/`, Sonnet default (3.5¢/image, out-ranks both math tiers), fresh session per image, prose only and no score (`rubric-v2`: self-agreement ICC 0.51), `prompts/` in the repo keyed by `prompt_id`.
